name: Extensions - Awesome Pi Coding Agent
description: A Bun-native extension pack for Pi: web access, subagents, revamped core tools, ANSI-compatible themes, fzf-style completions, Telegram mode, and more. ... Configurable web access extension for pi with per-tool provider routing and explicit provider option schemas for search, contents, quick grounded answers, and research. ... Pi tools for context-safe plain-text web, GitHub, Wikipedia, Reddit search, and page fetch.
